question: A specific extrinsic semiconductor block has a length of $0.1 \text{ m}$ and a cross-sectional area of $10^{-4} \text{ m}^2$. The electron concentration is $5 \times 10^{20} \text{ m}^{-3}$ and the hole concentration is $8 \times 10^{19} \text{ m}^{-3}$. A DC voltage of $5 \text{ V}$ is applied across its length. Given $\mu_e = 0.1 \text{ m}^2/\text{Vs}$ and $\mu_h = 0.05 \text{ m}^2/\text{Vs}$, what is the total current flowing through the block?
